description: This file implements a class 'FunctionFilter' which is a frame processor for Pipecat pipelines. It filters frames based on a user-defined asynchronous filter function, allowing flexible control over which frames pass through in the pipeline, with options to control filtering behavior for system frames and direction.

classes.name: FunctionFilter
classes.description: A frame processor that filters frames using a custom asynchronous filter function, with control over filtering system and lifecycle frames.

methods.name: __init__( self, filter: Callable[[Frame], Awaitable[bool]], direction: FrameDirection = FrameDirection.DOWNSTREAM, filter_system_frames: bool = False, )
methods.description: Initializes the FunctionFilter with a user-provided async filter function, filtering direction, and option to filter system frames.

methods.name: _should_passthrough_frame(self, frame, direction)
methods.description: Determines whether a frame should bypass filtering based on its type, direction, and filtering options.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection)
methods.description: Processes a given frame by applying the filter logic, and forwards the frame if it passes the filter or if bypassed.
